description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specified region.

description.zh:
资源组名称。
> 当该值为空时，返回所有资源组详情；当该值不为空，则返回指定资源组详情
description.en:
The name of the resource group.

> If this parameter is omitted, details for all resource groups are returned. Otherwise, only details for the specified resource group are returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-db-resource-group --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --resource-group-name testgroup --region cn-hangzhou
